integrity: The infinite theorem is based on explicit exact affine and return-map arguments. The embedded finite integer tests are corroboration, not independent mathematical certification. Priority remains subject to unindexed equivalent literature.
scientific_limitations: The proof covers only integer b >= 1 and alpha = 2 b + 1; it does not settle other parameter pairs or assert a complete two-parameter classification.
title: Global periodicity and exact cycle multiplicities for unit-gap nonlinear lattice rotations
